title: Make Codex and Cursor session test setup map directly to the domain

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-261#map-host-continuation-test-data

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision:** `.planning/seeds/SEED-261-share-domain-test-data.md#map-host-continuation-test-data` at ed48a61d6a07d650bf6cbec5dcd6db2b99c0849c; plan 539-map-host-continuation-test-data.
- **Promise (Key example 1):** A kept Codex thread has a saved endpoint and workspace; opening its terminal resumes that thread with the saved endpoint and working directory.
- **Why this promise, not Example 4:** Example 4's "UUID and resume arguments name the same conversation" lives in synthetic fixture data (`dashboard/tests/runningCursorSessionsPage.ts` answerCrowd); breaking it would mean altering the fixture, which this check must leave intact. Example 1 has a product path and a maintained assertion.
- **Fault:** `dashboard/server/hosts/codex/terminal.ts` (`attachCodex`): removed `cwd: continuation.workspace,` from the `spawnPty` options, so the resumed `codex` process starts in the dashboard's process directory instead of the saved workspace (the `--cd` argument still named the workspace). One-line deletion; fixture and assertion untouched.
- **Fixture:** `makeMe.aLaunchRecord.refining(...).inCodexSession({ sessionId: "saved-conversation", continuation: { workspace, endpoint } }).please()` saved before server start, with the fake Codex host (`installFakeCodex`, "on-start").
- **Maintained assertion:** `dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-codex-startup.spec.ts:105`, test "saved Codex conversation reconnects after daemon loss at startup": `expect(codexAttaches(native)[0]).toMatchObject({ cwd: realpathSync(workspace), args: ["resume", "--remote", endpoint, "--cd", workspace, "--no-alt-screen", "saved-conversation"] })`.
- **Scratch checkout:** detached `git worktree` of ed48a61d6 at `/Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/dad7506e/tmp/ic-scratch`, pre-probe `git status --porcelain` empty; `node scripts/setup-native.mjs npm` succeeded (Node v24.21.0 matching `.node-version`). Execution checkout and git stash were not touched.
- **Command (all three runs):** `env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH npx playwright test --config dashboard/playwright.config.ts dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-codex-startup.spec.ts -g "saved Codex conversation reconnects after daemon loss at startup" --reporter=list`
- **Baseline:** 1 passed (test 1.6s) — the selected test ran.
- **Fault run:** 1 failed at line 105 (`toMatchObject`). The diff showed the args array unchanged (`--remote <endpoint> --cd <workspace> ... saved-conversation`) and only `cwd` changed: expected `/private/var/folders/.../dough-codex-startup-1grHpK/home/git/open-dough`, received `/Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/dad7506e/tmp/ic-scratch`. That shows the fault ran on the intended terminal-attach path, the earlier daemon/observation assertions all passed, and the intended assertion failed on the changed working directory.
- **Restoration:** Restored from a byte copy (with an EXIT trap as backup). Afterwards `git diff --quiet` was clean and `git status --porcelain` was empty, the same as before the probe. The restored run had 1 passed (test 474ms). The scratch worktree was then removed with `git worktree remove`.

## Cost

- **Test runtime (measured, Playwright list reporter, wall time per run):** baseline 5.0s (test 1.6s); fault run test 462ms (failed); restored 1.5s (test 474ms).
- **Human effort:** unavailable. No human took part in this delegated run, so there is no separate measure.
- **Agent effort:** unavailable. No separately supported token or tool-time measure is exposed to this agent. About 14 tool calls were made (counted, not a time measure).


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 67534 ms (measured), from 1794169671842 to 1794169739376 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
